title: Load preview captures on intent and limit startup work
context: PR 16 failed the mobile LCP and blocking-time gates; all four homepage preview captures were initially rendered.
options: Render every capture and prefetch navigation routes.
Load additional captures on focus or hover and navigate through native links.
choice: Retain font swap, preload route-specific faces, load inactive captures on intent, and contain offscreen layout with hydration boundaries.
tradeoff: Native links reload the document and reset transient layer state. Additional previews may briefly wait for their first image request.
